name: AB S.A.
summary: AB S.A., together with its subsidiaries, distributes IT products primarily in Poland, the Czech Republic, and Slovakia. It engages in the wholesale trade of computers, computer hardware, toys, multimedia, electronic equipment, audiovisual equipment, and household appliances; licensing of computer programs; retail trade in computer hardware; toys; manufacturing of personal computers; leasing of warehouses; and logistics activities.
